name: portfolio
description: Yamlak Negash — MERN portfolio (web = React + Vite, backend = Express + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix admin run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix admin install
